name: Sakimori Shino
source:
Shino has incredible skills in swordsmanship, and she usually carries around a large wooden sword. She sees [url=http://vndb.org/c11300]Ai[/url] as her direct commander because she's the class representative and therefore has a higher status than her. Due to this, Shino is one hundred percent loyal to her. 
She hates to be called by her last name (Sakimori) for some reason.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maple_Colors_2]Wikipedia[/url] and roughly translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=559385]Getchu[/url].]
